title: Northern Arizona University (NAU)
summary: Northern Arizona University (NAU) is a university in Flagstaff. This entry compiles College Scorecard figures and related sources; UniRepository is not affiliated with NAU.

sections.heading: What NAU is known for
paragraphs: Northern Arizona University (NAU) is a public institution known for its diverse academic offerings and large undergraduate enrollment of 22,903 students. The university has an admission rate of approximately 89.6%, reflecting its inclusive approach to higher education. NAU is particularly recognized for its strong programs in business and health-related fields, with business programs comprising about 17.3% and health programs about 15.9% of the total academic offerings. These areas highlight the university's commitment to preparing students for careers in vital sectors of the economy.

sections.heading: Key strengths
paragraphs: Northern Arizona University (NAU) is a public institution with notable strengths in health and education programs. Health-related fields constitute approximately 15.9% of the university's academic offerings, reflecting a significant focus on preparing students for careers in healthcare. Education programs also represent a substantial portion, accounting for about 7.5% of the total programs available. These areas underscore NAU's dedication to addressing critical workforce needs in both health and education sectors.

sections.heading: Popular majors
paragraphs: Northern Arizona University (NAU) offers a range of popular majors that reflect its diverse academic environment. Business programs are the most prominent, making up about 17.3% of the university's academic offerings. Health-related majors follow closely, representing approximately 15.9% of the programs. Education is another significant area of study, accounting for around 7.5% of the academic focus. Smaller but notable shares include public administration at 2.3% and computer-related programs at nearly 2.0%. These distributions illustrate NAU's commitment to providing varied educational opportunities aligned with workforce demands.

sections.heading: How to read NAU tuition
paragraphs: Northern Arizona University (NAU) provides distinct tuition rates for in-state and out-of-state students. The tuition for in-state students is $13,009, reflecting the reduced cost for residents of Arizona. Out-of-state students are charged a higher tuition rate of $29,881. The overall cost of attendance, which includes tuition along with additional fees and expenses, amounts to $29,933. Understanding these figures helps prospective students and families plan for the financial commitment associated with attending NAU.

sections.heading: Financial aid
paragraphs: Northern Arizona University (NAU) offers financial aid options to support students in managing educational expenses. Approximately 31.26% of students receive Pell Grants, which are federal subsidies for those with financial need. Among students who complete their programs, the median debt incurred is $19,000, indicating the typical borrowing amount. For detailed information on financial aid and to estimate personal costs, prospective students can use NAU's net price calculator available on their official website. Additional data and comparisons can be found through the U.S. Department of Education's College Scorecard.

Among students who complete their programs, the median debt incurred is about $19,000. These figures provide insight into the career outcomes and financial considerations for students attending NAU.

paragraphs: Northern Arizona University (NAU) exhibits a diverse student body with a gender distribution of approximately 37% men and 63% women. This demographic mix reflects NAU's commitment to fostering an inclusive campus environment.
